import unittest

from solution import logical_right_shift


class LogicalRightShiftTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_positive_values(self):
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(0b110100, 2, 6), 0b1101)
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(255, 4, 8), 15)
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(1, 0, 32), 1)

    def test_negative_values_use_low_width_bits(self):
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(-1, 1, 8), 127)
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(-2, 1, 8), 127)
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(-128, 7, 8), 1)
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(-1, 4, 4), 0)

    def test_high_bits_outside_width_are_discarded(self):
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(0b101101, 1, 4), 0b110)
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(256, 0, 8), 0)
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(257, 0, 8), 1)

    def test_shift_at_least_width_returns_zero(self):
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(-1, 8, 8), 0)
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(123, 9, 8), 0)

    def test_default_width_is_32(self):
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(-1, 31), 1)
        self.assertEqual(logical_right_shift(-1, 32), 0)

    def test_all_arguments_require_non_boolean_integers(self):
        cases = [
            (True, 1, 8),
            (1, False, 8),
            (1, 1, True),
            (1.0, 1, 8),
            (1, "1", 8),
            (1, 1, None),
        ]
        for args in cases:
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    logical_right_shift(*args)

    def test_ranges(self):
        for width in (0, -1):
            with self.subTest(width=width):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    logical_right_shift(1, 0, width)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            logical_right_shift(1, -1, 8)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
